en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Aban Bin Usman, from Ibn Abu Yafour, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘A man came to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, so he said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! I asked a man by the Face of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so he whipped me five lashes’. So the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> whipped him another five lashes and said: ‘Ask by your own ignoble face’.
